fato_historico: 1905: Albert Einstein's paper that leads to the mass–energy equivalence formula, E = mc², is published in the journal Annalen der Physik.
energia_do_dia: Today, your radiant spirit may feel like a powerful spark of pure potential. Just as mass and energy are beautifully interconnected, your thoughts and actions are creating a dynamic force in your life. It is a good time to embrace your inner light and transform your creative ideas into something truly tangible and magnificent.
frase_do_dia: Your unique spark holds the power to light up the entire universe.
significado_numero: A master number representing the manifestation of dreams into reality.
conselho: Consider how your smallest actions can generate immense positive energy for your future.
